infobox.usage: Unlocks the USEC stash inside the hydroelectric power station on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The HEP station storage room key (HEPS) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the USEC stash inside hydroelectric power station, located somewhere near the Azure Coast sanatorium.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be be obtained as a reward for completing the quest Nostalgia from Jaeger.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text:
On the second floor of the power station on Shoreline.
- This location has 2 different doors that can be unlocked. Opening each door will use a point of durability on the key.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Weapon box (4x4)
- 1x Weapon box (6x6)
- 1x Weapon box (6x4)
- 1x Toolbox
- Loose loot (Weapon mods)
- Intelligence folder spawn on the cabinet
